title: Build a plain-text accounting engine to its specification
summary: A ledger/hledger-style engine from a long spec: amounts in many forms with inferred display precision, a journal parser (costs, virtual postings, inferred amounts, balance assertions in date order, includes, aliases, tags, periodic transactions), market prices with inverse rates, queries, balance/register/income-statement/period reports, budgets, and a command line with exact output.
